rules.statement: A session's sellable capacity is reduced by club bookings that overlap it: halved when one half of the rink is blocked and zero when both halves are blocked.
rules.subject: session effective capacity

rules.statement: Tickets already held by pending or paid bookings plus the tickets requested must not exceed the session's effective capacity.
rules.subject: tickets sold per session

rules.statement: For each skate size, hire skates already held plus those requested must not exceed the hire stock for that size.
rules.subject: hire skates per size

rules.statement: A booking cannot hire more skates in total than it has tickets.
rules.subject: hire skates per booking

rules.statement: A membership booking covers exactly one ticket.
rules.subject: tickets per membership booking

rules.statement: A member can use free sessions only while their pending or paid member tickets for that month are below the monthly free allowance (MEMBER_FREE_PER_MONTH).
rules.subject: member free sessions per month

rules.statement: The ticket on a membership booking is free; only skate hire is charged.
rules.subject: membership ticket price

evidence.quote: if (session.status === "held") throw new DomainError("conflict", "session is on hold: ticket sales are paused");

rules.statement: Tickets cannot be bought for a session that is on hold or cancelled.
rules.subject: session status for ticket sales

rules.statement: A pending booking must be paid within its payment window (15 minutes); once the window has elapsed it expires and its tickets and skates are released.
rules.subject: booking payment window

rules.statement: A new booking's payment deadline is its creation time plus the payment window.
rules.subject: booking expiry time

evidence.quote: if (session.status !== "held") throw new DomainError("conflict", "session is not on hold");

rules.statement: Only a session that is on hold can be released back on sale.
rules.subject: session status for release

rules.statement: Only a session that is on hold (or already cancelled, when retrying) can be cancelled. Cancelling refunds every paid booking and expires every pending one.
rules.subject: session status for cancellation

rules.statement: Tickets are available only for sessions that are scheduled or released; any other session shows zero tickets left.
rules.subject: session ticket availability

evidence.quote: if (input.end <= input.start) throw new DomainError("validation", "end must be after start");

rules.statement: A session must end after it starts.
rules.subject: session end time

evidence.quote: if (!isPosInt(input.capacity)) throw new DomainError("validation", "capacity must be a positive integer");

rules.statement: Session capacity must be a positive whole number.
rules.subject: session capacity

rules.statement: The ticket price must be a non-negative whole number of cents.
rules.subject: session ticket price

rules.statement: The skate hire price must be a non-negative whole number of cents.
rules.subject: session hire price

rules.statement: Hire stock quantity for a size must be a non-negative whole number.
rules.subject: hire stock quantity

evidence.quote: if (!isPosInt(input.tickets)) throw new DomainError("validation", "tickets must be a positive integer");

rules.statement: A booking must be for at least one ticket, as a whole number.
rules.subject: tickets per booking

evidence.quote: if (!isPosInt(qty)) throw new DomainError("validation", `hire quantity for size ${size} must be a positive integer`);

rules.statement: Each requested hire skate quantity per size must be a positive whole number.
rules.subject: hire quantity per size
